description:
## Question

Implement the per-shell buck2 option as settled, put the pinned buck2 on PATH of the selected shells, expose read-only `turnkey.buck2.version` (welcome message included), and make `buck2`/`buck2-toolchain` in any declaration file a hard evaluation error naming the migration note. Migrate turnkey's own toolchain.toml/flake.nix and the default template.
title: Replace toolchain.toml buck2 declarations with the per-shell option
